headline: 仙逆剧场版领跑电影，乌鸦学园等新剧首播
summary: 今日影市以《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》等热作为主；剧集方面，《乌鸦学园》《魔女嘉莉》等新剧首播，《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》持续热播。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》《另一个妈妈》《挖掘者》《不存在的罪人》《只要活下去》
industryHighlights.en: Film heat: Xian Ni: Slaying Immortals, Another Mother, The Digger, The Nonexistent Sinner, Just Live On

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《乌鸦学园》《魔女嘉莉》《Mayday》《库比蒂诺》《暗潮之下》
industryHighlights.en: New TV premieres: Crow Academy, Carrie, Mayday, Cupertino, Under the Dark Tide

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》《母狮》《无职转生》《末日地堡》

headlineEn: Xian Ni film leads movies; Crow Academy among new TV premieres
summaryEn: Today's film slate is led by Xian Ni: Slaying Immortals; on TV, Crow Academy and Carrie premiere while Reacher and Lanterns stay hot.
